data.title: Couldn’t refresh the review list

steps: In the Review workbench, press r to refresh again.
From the message box, press Alt+U.

data.title: Review couldn’t confirm what finished
data.outcome: Don’t retry the selected item yet; Review could not confirm the result.
steps: Run /review details to inspect the error.
Check the current Review status before retrying.
